integrations.scope: certified spider middleware: persistent duplicate filtering
integrations.limitations: The DBM database must be on a writable local filesystem.
Periodic monitor extensions use Twisted LoopingCall and are not certified.
Native engines do not wire the DUPEFILTER_CLASS setting; RedisPipeline requires the opt-in asyncio reactor.

integrations.scope: browser-service request and middleware integration (no external Splash service)
integrations.limitations: Set slot_policy='single_slot' to avoid private downloader._get_slot_key; external Splash service is not certified.
Uses private _get_serialized_fields, absent in both Scrapy 2.19 and SpiderOxide; last release was 2019.
scrapy.resolver.dnscache is not backed by SpiderOxide DNS; a stub would hide broken ban tracking.

integrations.scope: browser handler rejects initialization without an opt-in reactor
integrations.limitations: The handler imports but requires an installed asyncio reactor; actual Playwright browser execution is not certified.
Without the opt-in asyncio reactor, process_item returns a Deferred that cannot complete.

integrations.scope: Redis item pipeline with opt-in Twisted asyncio reactor
integrations.limitations: Requires spideroxide[twisted] and TWISTED_REACTOR; repeated crawls must share the installed asyncio loop.
